audit.why: EVEN / 6/10 on 51.96% over 179 games. She owns the middle of the lane through Heroic Charge and Steadfast Presence; you own two items onward against a tank with no damage.
audit.corrected: Difficulty and carry threat unchanged, matching the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Quinn, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Quinn, Poppy, Poppy in both layers. The packet and the audited mirror read Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Quinn.
audit.why: Five rows disagreed, and the page's own whys already argued the packet version: whys[0] says level 1 is 'genuinely even', whys[1] tells you not to trade at 2, whys[3] calls 4-5 'a skill standoff', whys[4] calls 6 'her window', and whys[6] says you reclaim the late. The most damaging one was the final row, which told the reader Poppy owns two-plus items while the paragraph under it said the opposite.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 6 re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers, with ratings realigned to the inverse of the mirror's: 5, 4, 4, 5, 3, 4, 7.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has the two decisive interactions; the full layer has neither. It never mentions that Steadfast Presence stops your Vault outright, never states that Heroic Charge only stuns into terrain, and never mentions the channel exchange at level 6.
audit.why: Riot text — Steadfast Presence (W, 20/18/16/14/12s): 'stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.' Vault is your only dash, so this is a hard counter to it. Heroic Charge (E, 14/13/12/11/10s): 'If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned' — no wall, no stun, which makes open-lane positioning the whole answer. Keeper's Verdict (R) is flagged channel, so Vault's brief interrupt cancels it; conversely Heroic Charge's stun cancels your Behind Enemy Lines channel.
audit.corrected: All of it written into the full layer with real numbers, and the channel exchange stated in both directions.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Poppy 'he' and 'him' throughout.
audit.why: Poppy is female; the content layer already uses 'her' consistently, so the two layers disagree on the page.
audit.corrected: Fixed in every field I touched, including breakdown.mid and breakdown.feeding.

edits.before: Behind Enemy Lines exports your lead — roam on every shove. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Poppy's ultimate changes the math too.
